correctness.rationale: Proof constructs explicit strictly positive except two zero coordinate witnesses for each pair n>=4; for n=3 diagonal/incidence pair forces further vanishing and is not a ridge. The row-sum tangent projection P=I-R*(RR*)^-1 R with RR*=nI/2 + 11^T/2 gives norm-squared DD (n-1)^2/n², off D/(2n²), and five unnormalized projected products 1/n²,-(n-1)/n²,1/n²,-(n-2)/(2n²),1/n². Interior angle cosine is minus normalized product. Counts DD C(n,2), DOinc n(n-1), DOnon C(n,2)(n-2), OOshared n C(n-1,2), OOdisjoint 3C(n,4), except DOinc removed for n=3. Exact arcsin convexity yields mean angle sign for n>=4 and n=3 formula positive. OOdisjoint weight 1-O(1/n) and +2/n² angle, OOshared weight 4/n and -1/n angle, hence n² random limit 2, mean -2, n³variance 4. Independent numerical checks across n=3,4,5,10,100,1000 and inspected exact fraction inverse Gram code for n=3..7 support but cannot prove all n.
